subject: HorizonBank onboarding: access governance kickoff and runbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Jackson <tim.jackson@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: HorizonBank onboarding: access governance kickoff and runbook

Hi Tim —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the HorizonBank pilot. We want to align on access controls and the initial cutover plan so your security team has everything needed for SSO, SCIM provisioning, and the network allowlists prior to the pilot start.

Core items we propose covering in this kickoff:
- SSO/SAML metadata exchange and IdP test users
- SCIM provisioning: groups, mapping, and deprovision cadence
- IP allowlist & egress requirements for the dedicated environment
- Service account patterns for automation and CI/CD
- Org policies and role mapping for least-privilege access
- Evidence list for your compliance review (audit logs, retention config)

I've attached a short playbook and a mutual action plan that maps owners and target dates. Quick asks for your team before our call:
1) Confirm an IdP contact and a test IdP entry (SAML metadata)
2) Provide the static egress IP CIDR(s) for your firewall team, or confirm you prefer IP-based VPN whitelisting
3) Any org policies (naming, RBAC tiers) you want pre-seeded into the onboarding runbook

Proposed time: Thu Aug 21, 10am PT — please propose alternatives.

Next steps from our side: Monica will own the SCIM schema recommendations; Ben will coordinate service account templates and Ops runbook.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-access-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook, 6 pages); mutual-action-plan-HB-099.xlsx (MAP)

From: Timothy Jackson <tim.jackson@horizonbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: HorizonBank IT <it@horizonbank.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HorizonBank onboarding: access governance kickoff and runbook

Marissa — thanks for the clear list. A few clarifications from our side: 
- IdP contact will be me (tim.jackson@horizonbank.com); we use Okta currently. I can share SAML metadata by Wednesday.
- For egress, our security lead prefers to manage allowlists via our perimeter firewall. I will aim to provide static CIDRs but may need a VPN option if those change; can you confirm Redwood supports both static CIDR whitelisting and VPN endpoint allowlisting?
- On SCIM: we typically provision groups by AD group name mapped to app roles. Can you share your recommended attribute map?

Also, for audit evidence, we require 13 months of retention for auth logs. Is that configurable on your side or do you capture and export to our bucket?

If Thu 10am PT works we can keep that; otherwise Thu 3pm PT is ok.

Thanks,
Tim
Timothy Jackson
Director, Infrastructure Security — HorizonBank
+1 415-555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Jackson <tim.jackson@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HorizonBank onboarding: access governance kickoff and runbook

Hi Tim —

Thanks — quick answers inline and a proposed SCIM attribute map attached.

- Okta: yes, we support Okta SAML; please send SAML metadata (or an IdP metadata URL) and I will generate the SP metadata for your team to import.
- Allowlisting: Redwood Dedicated supports static egress CIDRs and a VPN endpoint allowlist. If you expect churn in IPs, we can set a VPN fallback and document the handoff steps for your firewall team.
- SCIM mapping: attached is a recommended mapping (AD group -> appRole), with a suggested deprovision delay of 3 days for accidental removals. If you need immediate revocation for higher-risk groups we can set a per-group policy.
- Audit retention: we can export auth and admin audit logs to your S3 bucket; Redwood stores 90 days by default on the control plane but can push to your storage for 13 months — we'll note that in the MAP as an action item for Security/Engineering to validate.

Attachments: scim-attribute-map-hb.docx (example mapping), redwood-access-playbook-v1.pdf (same as initial).

Action items I will own before the call:
- Deliver SP metadata and test user instructions (Monica) — target Wed EOD
- Draft SCIM group mapping and deprovision policy for review (Monica)
- Service account template for automation (Ben)

Marissa: can you confirm the meeting invite time (Thu 10am PT) and share a dial-in?

Cheers,
Monica
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
